items.title: 'Chaos Zero Nightmare' Collaboration Kicks Off in September; 'Epic Seven' Unveils 8th Anniversary Showcase
items.summary: ©Super CreativeSuper Creative released the INFINITY Showcase video today (Aug. 22) to celebrate the 8th anniversary of its hero collector RPG, 'Epic Seven'.
items.content:
Super Creative released the INFINITY Showcase video today (Aug. 22) to celebrate the 8th anniversary of its hero collector RPG, 'Epic Seven'. In this showcase, Producer Tak Kwang-jin and Development Director Heo Dae-kyun appeared to announce key details, including the 8th anniversary update, online and offline events, and the roadmap ahead.

Side story episode 'Paradise Lost' unveiled, covering the very first Era

For this 8th anniversary, Epic Seven will delve into the 1st Era, the earliest period in its lore. Previously, Epic Seven mainly portrayed the story of the protagonist Ras fulfilling his mission as the Heir of the Covenant in the Seventh World, and subsequently becoming human to travel across the realm, overcoming crises alongside new companions. Since then, starting with the 6th Era episode in 2025 and the 5th Era side story episode 'Rain of Fading Embers', the game expanded its universe by showcasing settings and characters from previous eras. Now, with the 8th anniversary, Epic Seven aims to firmly establish its lore based on its origin story.

The 1st Era takes place before Ras existed, centering around Kayron as a human before becoming an Apostle, Politis who came to Orbis while investigating the truth behind the destruction of her homeworld, and Lizette, the manifestation of Goddess Diche. The central hero, Lizette, is a Light-element Soul Weaver who sacrificed everything to protect Orbis. Reflecting this concept, she possesses a passive skill that revives allies as Shards of Life. Allied heroes in the Shard of Life state take no damage and return to their original hero form after 2 turns to rejoin the battle. Her Skill 3, 'Convergent Time', restores the Health of all allies and increases Speed for 3 turns. If she is in the Divinity state, she triggers 'Time Rewind' for all allies except herself, resetting them to the state they were in at the start of battle.

Another major hero, 'Unknown Pioneer Politis', showcases a unique gimmick fitting her pioneer concept, where her assigned role changes based on her placement. When placed in the front row, she receives an offensive role, and when in the back row, she receives a defensive role, altering her skill effects accordingly—making strategic placement based on team composition a key point. Additionally, Kayron before becoming an Apostle, named 'Cain', will appear as an NPC rather than a new summonable hero, while Apostle of the End Kayron will be introduced separately at a later date.

Offline mode support, quality-of-life improvements, and content overhauls announced

Following the introduction of the Paradise Lost story, details regarding quality-of-life improvement patches were unveiled. First, offline mode support will be added to Battle Delegation. Previously, playing Epic Seven required keeping auto-battle running continuously to farm Hunts, but going forward, Battle Delegation will operate offline based on actual clear records. Players can queue up to 100 Leifs (Stamina currency), and automatic equipment sale and extraction features will also apply. Alongside these improvements, an Equipment Charm Payback event will run for three weeks starting August 27 to reduce players' equipment enhancement burden. During this period, players can receive refunds in Greater Universal Equipment Charm Selection Chests proportional to the EXP spent on equipment enhancement.

Additionally, 'Ogre's Armory', which previously served as early-game equipment farming content, has seen lower utility due to revamped early progression systems. As a result, it will be integrated into the Hunt menu as the new 'Ogre Hunt'. In Ogre Hunt, players will be able to obtain the Revenge, Counter, Opening, and Pursuit sets, which were previously obtainable only in Rift. Meanwhile, 'Rift'—which was initially added to capture the feel of massive boss battles—has become repetitive farming content and overlaps with other modes, so it will be temporarily removed and re-released after an overhaul.

In addition to PvE combat content, customization elements will be expanded. Profile Cards will see their max layers increased to 130 and available slots expanded to 10. New colors, shapes, and emotes will also be added, along with a feature allowing players to position elements by directly entering coordinates. PC hotkeys will also be supported, and a friend gifting feature will be added.

Meanwhile, a new PvP mode named 'Call of Chaos' will be added. Call of Chaos is a new mode in World Arena, designed as a 3v3 arcade-style PvP where players can jump straight into the fun of battle. The pick/ban phase lasts about one minute and drops the sequential pick/ban system in favor of displaying random heroes all at once for battle. Players can reroll heroes they wish to swap up to two times to build their team.

The win condition also differs. While traditional World Arena requires defeating all enemy heroes to win, Call of Chaos awards victory to the side that destroys the enemy's rear-row Guardian first. As long as the Guardian is alive, it continuously revives fallen heroes, offering a thrill of dynamic comebacks distinct from standard battles. Additionally, the roguelike element 'Destiny' will appear during battle, allowing players to buff allies or debuff enemies to turn the tide. A Call of Chaos run ends upon reaching 7 wins or 3 losses; rewards increase with each victory, and completing a run awards ranking points and shop currency. Season ranks will be tallied based on ranking points, granting additional rank rewards.

Chaos Zero Nightmare collaboration kicks off in September; permanent roguelike mode 'Dimension Exploration' added

Additionally, a collaboration with Super Creative's other anime collector RPG, 'Chaos Zero Nightmare', has been confirmed for September. The story will follow Renoa, Haru, and Meyrin after they crash-land into the world of Epic Seven due to a sudden Chaos Gate opening aboard the SS Nightmare. Among them, Renoa, who appears as a Moonlight hero, can be obtained for free during the event period, while Haru and Meyrin will be available through limited summons.

Along with the Chaos Zero Nightmare collaboration, a unique event incorporating various elements from Chaos Zero Nightmare into Epic Seven will unfold. For example, the 'Epione Center'—which treats crew members' mental breakdowns after exploration in Chaos Zero Nightmare—will be established in Witch Haven. Furthermore, the NPC Delang, who sells various goods inside the Chaos, will visit the world of Epic Seven to sell Chaos Zero Nightmare gear and various items adapted for Epic Seven.

items.summary: Provided by Smilegate ©SmilegateSmilegate announced on Wednesday, August 20, that Epic Seven, the mobile turn-based strategic RPG developed by Super Creative, will release an updat...
items.content:
Smilegate announced on Wednesday, August 20, that Epic Seven, the mobile turn-based strategic RPG developed by Super Creative, will release an update showcase video celebrating its 8th official launch anniversary.

The video will be released at noon on Saturday, August 22, on the official Epic Seven YouTube channel. Producer Tak Kwang-jin, who oversees Epic Seven's development, and Development Director (DD) Heo Dae-kyun will appear in the video to share their thoughts on reaching the 8th anniversary of service, while introducing major upcoming update content and commemorative events.

Having launched domestic service on August 30, 2018, Epic Seven previously unveiled the special hero 'Genesis Ras' with dedicated content, a new episode, extensive quality-of-life improvements, and an appreciation event offering various rewards through its 7th anniversary showcase video in August of last year. Additionally, the game received an enthusiastic response from players by announcing large-scale offline events, including news of Epic Seven's first-ever orchestra concert.

More detailed information about Epic Seven can be found on the official Epic Seven community and official YouTube channel.

items.title: ‘Epic Seven’ “Secret Summer” Update Live—New Limited Hero, Story, “Epic Dash” Event
items.summary: This week, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate have launched their latest summer update to their free-to-play turn-based role-playing game
items.content:
This week, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate have launched their latest summer update to their free-to-play turn-based role-playing game title ‘Epic Seven’ across PC and mobile platforms. This seasonal update includes a new Limited Hero, a Special Side Story, and the latest “Epic Dash” event. A special summer coupon code, “E7SUMMERGIFT26”, is also available for redemption until 26 August—you can redeem it in-game or by clicking over here .

The Limited Hero introduced for the 2026 summer season is Eye of the Abyss Fumyr. As a central figure in the newly added Special Side Story, “Show Me What Lies Within,” she visits the Aelo Coast to track the whereabouts of Harsetti, the sovran of Shadow Elves, only to find herself swept up in a series of unexpected incidents.

Eye of the Abyss Fumyr is a 5★ Earth Elemental Mage obtainable until July 16. Her Skill 3, “Eye of the Abyss,” inflicts “Detain” on the foremost enemy Hero, temporarily removing them from the battlefield. This allows players to collapse the enemy’s frontline and drive the battle to their advantage.

Story starring Fumyr will run for six weeks until 6 August. Set against a coastal backdrop, the narrative features a diverse cast of characters alongside Fumyr, including the information broker “Birgitta” and her assistant “Aube.” Notably, as players progress through the story, they can play a classic “territory-capture” style arcade mini game to acquire various rewards, including high-quality illustrations.

Meanwhile, the “Epic Dash” event will take place from June 25 to August 27, offering massive benefits for Hero acquisition and growth. Players can clear daily and weekly missions to level up their “Mission Pass” rank and claim rewards. Depending on their rank, players can obtain a 5★ Hero Selector that provides a Hero with all progression fully completed, a 5★ Limited Hero Selector, a standard 5★ Hero Selector, various Summon Currencies, Equipment Sets, and more.

Also, as part of the Epic Dash lineup, the “Premium Moonlight Summon” event will grant players up to 100 free Moonlight Hero summons simply by logging in daily. As an extra milestone bonus, players will receive a 5★ Light Elemental Hero Summon Ticket upon performing 20 summons, and a 5★ Dark Elemental Hero Summon Ticket upon performing 100 summons. Finally, the update brings the “Lucky Dash” event, where players can obtain various Equipment and Charms, alongside the “Epic Dash Buff” event, which provides several powerful in-game buffs.

The developer has also prepared a set of “Secret Summer Digital Merchandise” featuring wallpapers of some of Epic Seven’s heroines. You can download the images from the game’s official website (bottom of the page) to grab copies tailor-made for your PC, mobile, tablet, and watch.

Epic Seven is available as a free-to-play title across PC via STOVE , iOS , and Android via Google Play .

items.content:
Smilegate announced on the 26th that it has launched the summer season update for its mobile turn-based strategy RPG 'Epic Seven.' This update includes the new limited hero 'Abyssal Eye Fumir,' a special side story, and the 'Epic Dash' event.

The limited hero for summer 2026 is 'Abyssal Eye Fumir.' As a key figure in the special side story 'Show Me Even the Hidden Depths,' Fumir visits the 'Ailo Coast' to track the movements of the Shadow Elf King 'Harsetti,' where she encounters various incidents.

'Abyssal Eye Fumir' is a 5-star Earth-element Sorcerer hero available only until July 16. Her 3rd skill, 'Abyssal Eye,' inflicts an 'Imprison' effect that temporarily removes the front-most enemy hero from the battlefield, allowing players to disrupt the opponent's front line and create tactical variables in combat.

The special side story featuring Fumir, 'Show Me Even the Hidden Depths,' will run for six weeks until August 6. In addition to Fumir, the story features characters such as the information broker 'Birgitta' and her assistant 'Orb,' unfolding an adventure set against a coastal backdrop.

Players can also enjoy a minigame during the story. The minigame is designed in the style of the classic arcade 'territory-claiming' game, and players can earn rewards, including illustrations, by participating.

The 'Epic Dash' event, designed to support hero acquisition and growth, runs from June 25 to August 27. Players can complete daily or weekly missions to increase their 'Mission Pass' rank and earn rewards. These rewards include a fully leveled 5-star hero selector, a 5-star limited hero selector, a standard 5-star hero selector, summoning resources, and equipment sets.

A 'Special Moonlight Summon' event is also being held as part of Epic Dash. Players can receive up to 100 free Moonlight hero summons just by logging in daily. Additionally, players receive a 5-star Light-element hero summon card after 20 summons, and a 5-star Dark-element hero summon card after 100 summons.

Furthermore, the 'Lucky Dash' event, which provides equipment and enhancement stones, and the 'Epic Dash Buff' event, which offers gameplay-enhancing effects, are also underway.

More detailed information about 'Epic Seven' can be found on the official community and official YouTube channel.

items.title: Epic Seven Releases New Shepherd of the Dark Diene Update
items.summary: Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update
items.content:
Posted in: Games , Mobile Games , Video Games | Tagged: Epic Seven , Smilegate , Super Creative

Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update

Smilegate and developer Super Creative has launched a new update for Epic Seven , bringing with it a new character. Players now have access to Shepherd of the Dark Diene, a new Moonlight Hero who brings a different set of attacks and more to the fray, along with a New Year's event to kick off 2026. We have more details here as the content is live today.

Shepherd of the Dark Diene is a country girl who, after encountering a black wolf in the forest, forms a contract with Noias, the Dark Spirit Lord, who has appeared for the first time in centuries. Driven by her admiration for the Hero "Aki" and her unwavering determination, she embarks on her journey to save the world. But as her journey unfolds, it begins to transform into something dark and twisted. She is a 5★ Dark elemental Mage Hero who can lead battles to her advantage by utilizing various effects that trigger when she is granted "immortality." Her Skill 1, "Crimson Claws," inflicts rupture on the enemy, and a successful attack always results in a critical hit. Damage dealt increases proportionally to the caster's max Health. When the caster is granted immortality, it triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

Her Skill 2, "Noias's Guidance," grants immortality for 1 turn at the start of battle. Additionally, when someone uses a Soulburn, dispels all debuffs from the caster before activating "Dark Moon," which dispels buffs from all enemies, grants immortality to the caster for 3 turns, and increases Combat Readiness by 35%. Her Skill 3, "Endless Darkness," inflicts seal on all enemies for 2 turns, and attacks them before decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Also, a successful attack always results in a critical hit. When the caster is granted immortality, they ignore Effect Resistance.

To celebrate the New Year, Smilegate will also be running several in-game events. First, the "New Year Check-In Event" will run for three weeks until the 22nd. Players can log in to receive a New Year's greeting from Merurin. The New Year's Gift Chest includes Lv. 88 Equipment and "Fire Horse Stamps," which can be used in concurrent events. The second event, "Collect New Year Stamps," will run during the same period. By consuming Energy daily, players can obtain "Leif" and the event currency, "Fire Horse Stamps." In the third event, "New Year's Gift Arrived!," players can use the "Fire Horse Stamps" earned from the two events mentioned earlier to open random chests containing rewards such as MolaGora and Charms. Finally, in the "Merurin's Lucky Pouch" event, players can clear simple missions to earn various rewards, including a final reward of 1,000 Skystone.

items.title: The Sedin Cup, Drance vs. Harman: Which team wins a 7-game series? - The Athletic
items.summary: Two teams composed of Canucks greats will battle in an epic seven-game series for the right to hoist the Sedin Cup.
items.content:
Share article 45 In the absence of real hockey, the Boy Genius and Drancer have built juggernaut Vancouver Canucks teams constructed from the best seasons by Canucks players of the past 15 years.

Now that the teams have been selected, Harman and Drance’s Canucks will compete against one another in a tournament and the winner will be awarded the fictional Sedin Cup.

Thanks to the ingenuity of The Athletic ’s Dom Luszczyszyn, we can actually rate the teams Dayal and Drance constructed and have them play against one another in a simulated seven-game series. Using Dom’s model, we’ll project how these teams would have performed if you’d subbed them in for the actual 2019-20 Canucks roster in NHL play this season.

Once we’ve determined a projected point totals for both teams, the team that fares better will get home-ice advantage. And then the fun starts, as these two teams will battle in an epic seven-game series for the right to hoist the Sedin Cup.

You can read about the selection draft, the makeup of both teams and the rules of team composition here . Essentially these teams are built of the best single-season Canucks performances over the past 15 years, with the caveat that both rosters have to be cap compliant.

Before we get to how these teams would project over the course of an 82-game season, here’s the methodology behind Dom’s model and some of the estimates we’ve made:

Basically, I used the Game Score Value Added (GSVA) for each player’s respective season. For example, Henrik Sedin was worth 5.0 wins in 2009-10, the best season by a Canuck in the salary cap era thanks to his strong point production and play-driving ability. GSVA is just Game Score (a combination of box score metrics) translated to a win value above replacement level. For players selected before 2007-08 (before the NHL started collecting real-time stats), we used their point production from the given year and merged it with their play-driving metrics from 2007-08. It’s not ideal, but it’s what we had to do as a workaround.

Each game was “played” in the same way the current season is being simulated in this post : just once, using the win probability for each game based on the strength of each team. In order to squeeze every player into a realistic lineup, we used their per-minute win rate and applied it to an ice time estimate based on each player’s slot in the lineup for that particular game.

You’ll notice that Drance’s Canucks have more “total wins” by GVSA than Dayal’s do, but because Drance has superior depth outside of the 19 players that can dress every night, that may not hold up over the course of an 82 game – particularly assuming full health for both rosters, which we’re doing to keep things simple.

And, in fact, Dayal’s Canucks outperform Drance’s by a narrow margin based on the regular season projection.

The model projects that Dayal’s Canucks would amass a preposterous 125.9 points over an 82-game season , a point total that would exceed any managed by every NHL team in history save for five: the late 1970s Montreal Canadiens on three occasions, the 1995-96 Detroit Red Wings and the 2018-19 Tampa Bay Lightning .

The model projects that Drance’s Canucks would amass a still preposterous, but not quite as good 123.9 points over an 82-game season . That point total would represent the seventh-highest points total in the history of the NHL.

So Dayal’s Canucks get home-ice advantage and enter the Sedin Cup challenge series as the prohibitive favourite, with Dom’s model giving them a 56 percent chance of emerging as the victor.

items.title: Dodgers repeat as World Series champions after an epic 11-Inning Game 7 thriller of Blue Jays
items.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Toronto Blue Jays 5-4 in Game 7 to become the first team in 25 years to win consecutive World Series titles.
items.content:
Yoshinobu Yamamoto and Dave Robert talk about the Dodgers 2025 World Series win.

For 32 years, the Toronto Blue Jays waited for a night like this — a Game 7 under the lights, the city electric, the air trembling with belief. And when it finally came on a brisk November Saturday, it unfolded like a fever dream. History dangled by a thread. Every pitch, every heartbeat, every sound of leather meeting wood felt like it could tilt the universe.

And when it was over — when Yoshinobu Yamamoto snapped off one final splitter, when Vladimir Guerrero Jr.’s knees buckled and the Dodgers spilled out of the dugout in a tidal wave of blue — it was the Los Angeles Dodgers who stood atop the baseball world once again.

Stream Los Angeles News for free, 24/7, wherever you are.

Trailing by three runs early in the game, the Los Angeles Dodgers mounted a comeback for the ages, defeating the Toronto Blue Jays 5-4 in extra innings of Game 7 of the 2025 World Series , crowning the Dodgers as the first back-to-back champions since the Yankees of 1998-2000.

But this one — this one might be remembered forever.

"This was one of the greatest games I've ever been a part of," said a champagne-soaked Dodgers' manager Dave Roberts after the game. "We've just done something that hasn't been done in decades."

But before the celebration in Los Angeles, before the heartbreak in Toronto, before the pandemonium and chaos, there was Bo Bichette.

In the bottom of the third, with one swing, he turned Toronto’s hope into thunder. Shohei Ohtani, running on fumes and three days’ rest, hung a splitter that spun in the cold light like a balloon, and Bichette crushed it 443 feet into the second deck. Three runs. Three decades of frustration exhaled in a single, defiant roar.

BO BICHETTE BELTS ONE TO DEEP CENTER 🤯 @BLUEJAYS LEAD 3-0 IN GAME 7 pic.twitter.com/64ai0Udfyl

The Rogers Centre shook like a pressure cooker coming to a boil — the roof quivering, the crowd delirious. Canada believed again.

"That was right up there with George's [Springer] homer against Seattle. He went dead center on the first pitch, it was just so fitting," said Blue Jays manager John Schneider of Bichette's big homer. "What Bo did this year is nothing short of amazing. In that moment, it felt right."

Ohtani, the global icon, looked human — mortal under the weight of the moment . His night ended in the third, three runs down, head bowed, his eyes tracing the ground as Dave Roberts made the walk to get him. The Jays had seized control, and for the first time, the Dodgers looked rattled.

"Shohei has the weight of the world on his shoulders when it comes to expectations," said Roberts of his superstar. "He's the face of baseball, and he's going to be the MVP in the National League. It's really special what he's done. He's a great person and a great competitor. He just didn't have it tonight."

items.title: Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 attracts 61% more viewers than 2024
items.summary: The Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 drew 61% more viewers than last year, peaking at over 28,000. With expanded coverage, global co-casters, and thrilling matches, this year’s event became one of the most-watched tournaments in Epic Seven history
items.content:
On September 6, the Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 concluded at the YES 24 Live Hall in Seoul, South Korea. Thanks to a combination of factors, which we'll get into in detail below, it ended among the three most popular competitions in the game's history.

The most prestigious event in Epic Seven's calendar carried a prize pool of $100,000, the joint-most in the mobile role-playing title's competitive history. It brought together 64 of the world's best players as they vied for the title of world champion.

Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 – basic viewership stats and top channels

After around three weeks of action, Xiao Xuenai beat GOMEAWME 4:2 in the Grand Final to emerge as the victor and the title's newest world champ. For this achievement, he took home $50,000 and some special items, including a trophy, a Hero Skin, and a ring, with another reward to be revealed at the end of the year.

"After six years in Epic Seven, I've finally made it to the top of RTA. Standing at the bottom and looking up at that peak felt overwhelming, but I was blessed to have true companions by my side throughout this journey. I want to thank Smilegate from the bottom of my heart for hosting the 2025 World Championship, and I'm deeply grateful to my Shadow Council members — Hazamarei, Keith, Second, and everyone else — for all their support along the way. I'm so proud that I could make our shared dream come true by bringing this championship home to the Council. My sincere thanks also go to the Ps streaming community, Blue Sky, and everyone who stood behind me. I hope all the Heirs find their true friendships and passion within the world of Epic Seven."

- Xiao Xuenai, after clinching the Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025

The Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 peaked at 28,315 Peak Viewers on the first day of the event: August 16. On this day, the second installment of the Epic Seven 7th Anniversary Showcase was released , revealing updates for the second half of the year and including insights from the development team about future developments for the mobile RPG.

This helped it comfortably beat the concurrent viewers mark set at the Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2024 by 61%. It also ended in the third spot when looking at the most popular tournaments in the title's esports history, sitting behind the 2022 and 2023 editions.

Comparing the viewership statistics of the last two E7 World Arena Championships

One big reason for this massive jump from 2024 was the number of channels covering the event. It shot up from 33 to 84 this year, helped by an increased interest shown by a lot of community streamers, which also meant that two extra platforms covered the action in 2025: CHZZK and Kick.

What is heartening is the fact that many Western co-casters jumped at the chance to livestream the games and finished among the top channels list . Considering that Epic Seven is a niche game with a core market in Korea, the fact that Spanish and Portuguese-speaking content creators showed high interest helped take the title and its coveted competition to a lot of new viewers .

With a format that included multiple qualifiers and a main event in a double round robin leading into quarterfinals, semifinals, and a best-of-seven grand final, the Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 also finished as the game's second-most-watched competition ever. Only the 2022 iteration is ahead by this metric.

Epic Seven has joined a list of games boasting a more regional presence, like Honor of Kings, in seeking to expand its audience base recently . Making its most prestigious tournaments more visible and accessible via co-casters and broadcasting in more languages has paid dividends for the 2025 World Arena Championship, which easily outperformed last year's edition and put up some of the title's best livestreaming numbers.

As more and more such games adopt this method, it will be interesting to see how their livestreaming numbers hold up in the coming years. Esports Charts will continue to monitor tournaments across genres and tiers , and readers interested in detailed stats for such competitions can check out our Events Dashboard .

items.title: Epic Seven Review
items.summary: Epic Seven comes about as close to breaking the mold as I've ever seen. Although it does this at the cost of incorporating some gameplay mechanics better
items.content:
Though Epic Seven is worth a download, you're going to have to try it for yourself to see if it's worth the space on your phone.

What are some of the first things that come to mind when you think of mobile gacha games? Shallow gameplay, incessant power creep, and punishing summoning systems pretty much top the list for anyone even vaguely familiar with the genre. Some of the gaming industry’s worst practices are synonymous with gachas, and even the most respected gacha titles in the market can’t shake all the genre’s shortcomings.

Fire Emblem Heroes is still one of the biggest poster children for unbridled power creep despite Intelligent Systems’ improvements to the game following its release. Fate Grand Order distinguishes itself from its peers through excellent aesthetics and well-crafted narratives. But even after receiving six years of updates, its gameplay mechanics remain archaic, and its summoning system lacks many quality of life changes adopted by its contemporaries. Two steps backward almost always follow each step forward, and it’s almost impossible to find a title that doesn’t choose to die on one of these hills of gacha vices.

Epic Seven comes about as close to breaking the mold as I’ve ever seen. Although it does this at the cost of incorporating some gameplay mechanics better suited to an MMORPG than a mobile game, it proves an interesting if not worthwhile experience. Your mileage may vary, but the game’s appealing visuals, welcome summoning system, and sprawling amount of content make it worth taking a hard look at.

Epic Seven is a turn-based RPG in which you build teams of up to four heroes. Each hero is associated with one of five elements: earth, ice, fire, light, and dark. The latter two elements are vulnerable to each other, while the first three are strong or weak against one another in a rock-paper-scissors arrangement. Heroes also come in various classes. For example, thieves embody the archetype of high damage output but low survivability, and soul weavers fill the healer role while offering supporting abilities such as team resurrection. I recommend a balanced team of a tank, two damage dealers, and a healer for general PvE content. Still, the classes offer enough flexibility to support plenty of experimentation.

Every hero boasts two basic skills and an ultimate skill. While you may assume this skill system is shallow at first glance, the limited skill selection makes gameplay more cohesive and tight-knit. Every skill feels impactful, from basic skills to high-end ultimate abilities. Buffs and debuffs attached to most skills enhance this feeling. They often result in extreme damage and healing numbers that leave you supremely satisfied, and they can make lower-rarity heroes just as fun to use as five-star ones. For example, defense break, a common debuff, reduces a target’s defense by a massive 70%!

Sadly, Epic Seven ‘s story is not its selling point. You play as Ras Elclare, a human avatar of a faction of benevolent gods. Thanks to certain malevolent gods, Ras’ world is trapped in a cycle of constant destruction and rebirth. He journeys to end this vicious cycle once and for all. Unfortunately, the game’s meager writing and unwillingness to see certain plot twists through mar the story. After its introductory chapters, the game wraps consequential plot points in a noticeable layer of armor it refuses to shed, making the journey feel more like a long tutorial than an engaging piece of fiction. The campaign improves as you progress, but by and large, Epic Seven ‘s narrative goes in one ear and out the other.

Fortunately, you can sink your teeth into a lot more than the campaign. On the PvE end of things, you can dive into standard material/equipment grinding maps. Or you can explore sprawling labyrinths with a clever morale system that keeps you from steamrolling the entire map in one go. If you’re looking to test your team to its limit, you can try to clear Automaton Tower and Abyss, which handsomely reward you if your team is up to the task. Side stories — temporarily available sidequests — provide additional story content, though they amount to little more than snippets of lore and some extra loot.

Arena mode provides most of the game’s PvP content. In arena, you battle against other players’ teams to climb the ranks. You can also battle other players in real-time in the world arena. After joining a guild, those who prefer teamwork can participate in guild wars, a slightly modified version of arena with rarer rewards.

The absence of significant power creep among new heroes helps keep gameplay balanced. In fact, many of the most powerful characters to this day have been available since close to release. Generally speaking, the design philosophy behind new heroes focuses on breadth and emphasizes new combat styles or fresh takes on already-existing ones.

Epic Seven has you covered even if you enjoy the hero-collecting aspect of gacha games over their actual gameplay. You earn skystones, the game’s premium currency, through quests, campaign progression, and in-game events. You mainly use skystones to acquire covenant bookmarks, a currency you can spend to summon new heroes. Though you can trade skystones for bookmarks directly, players seeking to maximize efficiency may want to use skystones to refresh the secret shop on the home screen. By doing so, you can usually acquire bookmarks at a more favorable rate. The game also incentivizes you to refresh the secret shop by giving each refresh a chance to yield mystic medals. You can use mystic medals to obtain rarer light and dark heroes, though doing so significantly dents your reserves of gold.

The game’s normal banners — events that offer boosted odds of summoning certain heroes — are similarly generous. Though they only offer a 1% chance to summon a specified five-star hero (that banner’s “rate-up” hero), you’re guaranteed to summon the hero after 120 summons. What’s more, when you net a five-star hero, the banner ensures the hero you summon is its rate-up hero. As a result, you no longer need to worry about summoning pity breakers, unwanted five-star heroes that reset enhanced summoning odds. With just a bit of research on banner rotations and three to four weeks of diligent saving, you can grab any five-star hero that isn’t light or dark.

It’s a shame that the game locks five-star light and dark heroes behind more demanding summoning systems. You’ll have to save currency for months to obtain these heroes. Fortunately, they’re only relevant in PvP, and completing the campaign rewards you with one of six powerful, meta-relevant light and dark five-star heroes. So you’re not entirely out of luck if you’re interested in five-star heroes of the light or dark variety.

Epic Seven hits the brakes on the fun train once you get to its hero leveling and upgrade systems. Leveling demands extensive grinding, and you can take very few shortcuts to dodge this bullet. You also need to promote heroes to six stars to reach their maximum potential, which requires sacrificing five other five-star heroes. The game offers heroes designed for sacrifice, so you don’t need to burn through all your precious summons to obtain six-star ones. However, these sacrificial heroes mostly come in two, three, or four-star rarities, meaning you have to grind to promote them to five stars first.
